name: Site01 LDEM (surface height)
role: Terrain elevation: slope, aspect, hillshade, roughness, horizon
notes: README: surface-interpolated height Z; interpolation fills pixels with no LOLA return. Vertical reference is not stated in the README and still needs confirming from the paper. Pixel-registered grid (X/Y are pixel centres).
processing_steps: Read with rasterio; CRS verified against expected polar stereographic sphere
Slope/aspect: Horn 3x3 on the 5 m grid
Roughness: RMS residual from local plane, 5x5 px window
provider: NASA PGDA / LRO LOLA (Barker et al. 2021, doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119)
crs: South polar stereographic X/Y in metres on a Moon sphere of radius 1737.4 km (lat_0=-90, lon_0=0); MOON_ME frame of ephemeris DE421 (PGDA README)
coverage: Site01 'Connecting ridge', 16 km x 16 km: x -19000 to -3000 m, y -20000 to -4000 m (3200 x 3200 px, from the file)

name: Site01 LDEC (LOLA return count)

name: LOLA south-polar DEM (candidate: 80S gridded product)
role: Terrain elevation, slope, roughness and horizon calculation
notes: Candidate regional product, not used yet. Resolution, CRS, vertical reference and product date will be read from the downloaded GeoTIFF metadata in Phase 2, not assumed. Enhanced south pole products: https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/104

name: NAIF SPICE kernels (DE421 ephemeris, DE421 lunar orientation, MOON_ME frame)
role: Sun and Earth apparent positions seen from a point on the lunar surface
crs: MOON_ME (Mean Earth / polar axis, DE421 realisation), the same frame as the LOLA DEM
processing_steps: spkcpo: apparent vector (LT+S) from a fixed surface point in MOON_ME to the Sun / Earth
Rotated to local East-North-Up of the 1737.4 km sphere; azimuth clockwise from lunar north
Angular radius from IAU nominal solar radius 695,700 km and Earth equatorial radius 6,378.137 km
notes: Kernels: naif0012.tls (leap seconds), pck00011.tpc, moon_080317.tf + moon_assoc_me.tf (frames), moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc (orientation), de421.bsp (from spk/planets/a_old_versions). DE421 is used deliberately because the LOLA products are referenced to its MOON_ME frame.

name: JPL Horizons (validation reference)
role: Independent check of SPICE-derived Sun and Earth positions
crs: Horizons topocentric observer on the Moon (CENTER=coord@301), MEAN_ME frame, 1737.4 km sphere, DE441
coverage: 108 epochs: Sun and Earth at Site01 centre and Apollo 11, 2027-01 to 2027-03 and 2030-06
processing_steps: scripts/fetch_horizons_reference.py stores airless apparent az/el (quantity 4) in app/data/validation/horizons_reference.json
test_ephemeris.py compares every epoch; tolerance 0.001 deg; observed maximum difference about 0.00001 deg
notes: Not a runtime dependency. The comparison is re-run with the backend test suite (pytest).
